title: Chapter 1: a clean pick and place
judge_reason: the cube rests in the target zone and the gripper has released it
agent_summary: Picked the red cube up from [0.50, 0.00, 0.02] and placed it in the green target zone at [0.50, -0.25] using the standard top-down pick-and-place steps. Every move reached its target with at most 0.1 mm error. The grasp held (both fingers touching the cube), and the object tracker worked the whole time. check_task reported success: the cube is resting on the table 2 mm from the zone centre and the gripper is open. The front camera image confirms the cube is centred in the zone with the gripper clear above it. No problems came up.
